_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- INTERFEROMETER mode: the 2017 Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) and the M87* ring model
_meta.companion: data/interf/eht2017.md (same content as Markdown, with the full quote tables).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/interf/eht2017/ (params{} and ring_model{} hold the full records; stations[] carry their table-row quotes). DERIVED = arithmetic done here (shown). INFERRED = a mapping no source states. NOT FOUND = a gap. FITS READ-OFF = values decoded from the SR1 uvfits binary AN table. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.units: geocentric X, Y, Z in meters; latitude/longitude in degrees (east positive); heights in meters on GRS80; frequencies GHz; angles deg unless stated; ring sizes in microarcseconds (uas); SEFD Jy
_meta.quote_check: 136 quote records (127 distinct quotes) machine-checked against the saved files' extracted text (pdftotext -layout and -raw for the PDFs; the md, txt, csv, dat and JSON files as is; the uvfits header cards as text): all pass; 134 values (P2 Table 2 and P3 Table 2 numbers vs the station fields, the SR1 AN-table XYZ, GSTIA0 and target position decoded from the uvfits, the ehtim rows, P4 Tables 7 and 10, P6 Table 3, and the SR1 track spans recomputed from the csv files) re-parsed from the saved files: all match (2026-11-16).
_meta.quote_normalization: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), tilde operator and soft hyphens normalized; table-cell separators | dropped; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes with PDF line-end hyphenation closed up or with all whitespace removed; " ... " joins non-adjacent pieces. AAS font glyphs mapped before matching (verified by rendering the pages): U+F0B0 -> degree, U+F0B2 -> double prime, U+00A2 -> prime, U+00B4 -> multiplication sign, U+F0A0 -> space, U+0084 -> "⩽" (P4 p. 29), U+F088 -> "≲" (P1 p. 8), U+F089 -> "≳" (P1 p. 1). Empty AAS table cells (an em dash) extract as "L" and are quoted so. The uvfits header cards are checked as text.

adopted.model: crescent: thin ring with a dipolar brightness profile, blurred by a 10-uas Gaussian (P4 Appendix C.1, model 2, the synthetic crescent of the imaging tests)
adopted.formula: I(r, theta) = I0 [1 + 2A cos(theta - eta)] delta(r - r0) / (2 pi r0), then convolved with a circular Gaussian of FWHM 10 uas; theta and eta east of north
adopted.loc: Appendix C.1 item 2, Eq. (49); Sec. 9.2 (eta = 150 deg)
adopted.quote: A crescent composed of a delta-function ring with radius r0=22 μas and a dipolar angular intensity proﬁle

quote2.quote: where I0=0.55 Jy, the asymmetry parameter A=0.23 (see Section 9.1), and η is the orientation angle east of north. The crescent is then also convolved with a 10 μas Gaussian.

quote3.quote: synthetic data from a crescent model with asymmetry parameter A=0.23 oriented at a orientation angle η=150°

quote4.quote: The crescent models deﬁned in Section 6.1 have A=0.23, with angular brightness proﬁles

quote5.quote: In the simulated crescent, the diameter of the unblurred model is 44 μas

quote6.loc: Appendix C.1, Eq. (49) (Greek letters extract as Latin: q = theta, h = eta, p = pi)

adopted.derived: flux = integral of I = I0 = 0.55 Jy; brightness peak at theta = eta = 150 deg (southeast); peak/trough along the ring (1 + 2A)/(1 - 2A) = 2.70; A = |<I e^(i theta)>| / <I> = 0.23 by construction (P4 Eq. 22)

jet.note: P4 adds 0.6 Jy in a large-scale jet of three elliptical Gaussians to every synthetic model; inter-site baselines resolve it out

quote2.quote: All of our models have 0.6Jy of ﬂux density in a compact component and 0.6 Jy in an extended jet that is heavily resolved by EHT inter-site baselines.

construction.quote: Starting with a uniform circular disk of emission with radius Rout, we subtract a smaller uniform disk with radius Rin that is offset from the ﬁrst by an amount r0.
which imposes a linear brightness gradient along the symmetry axis. The brightness reaches a minimum of h1 and a maximum of h2.
The image is rotated such that the widest section of the crescent is oriented at an angle f in the counterclockwise direction (i.e., east of north).

gc_fits.note: GC parameters: d = Rout + Rin (Eq. 20); f_w = fractional width (Eq. 21); s = smoothing FWHM / d; f_c = floor / mean crescent brightness; phi = orientation of the widest (brightest) side, east of north. The xs-ringauss model also carries a fixed Gaussian and 2-3 nuisance Gaussians; the Rin, Rout, r0, h1, h2 values themselves are NOT FOUND in the saved sources (Table 3 lists only the derived quantities).

conflicts: Frame handedness: P2 Table 2 note a calls the X (Greenwich) / Y (90 deg east) / Z (north) frame "left-handed"; those axes form the standard right-handed ECEF frame, and the SR1 AN table declares XYZHAND = 'RIGHT'. The XYZ values convert to the tabulated latitudes, longitudes and GRS80 heights under the right-handed interpretation (to <= 2.2 m), so the word, not the numbers, is in error.

SEFDs: P3 Table 2 (median 2017 values on M87 and Sgr A*) vs P2 Table 3 (representative): APEX 4800 vs 4700, PV 6900 vs 1900 (P3 includes the 3.663 mitigation factor for the 2017 PV clock loss; 6900/3.663 = 1884), SMA 6400 vs 6200 Jy; the others equal. The ehtim files differ again (EHT2017_m87.txt: ALMA 70, APEX 4900, JCMT 10000, LMT 3600, PV 3600, SMA 5600/6500 R/L, SMT 14400, SPT 16900 Jy; EHT2017.txt: ALMA 90, LMT 600, PV 1400 Jy ...). Adopted: P3 Table 2.

Positions: the SR1 AN table (as correlated) matches P2 Table 2 to 0.06 m except ALMA (2.16 m; P2 note b: phasing center). The ehtim array files differ from P2 by 0.0-4.3 m at ALMA, APEX, JCMT, PV, SMT, but by 86 m at the LMT, 289 m at the SMA (the ehtim SMA point lies 3.1 m from the P2 position of the CSO, params.ehtim_check) and 1151 m at the SPT (ehtim X = Y = 0.01 m). Adopted: P2 Table 2.
P2 Table 2 SMA longitude -155°28′39.1″ vs -155°28′39.17″ from the P2 XYZ of the SMA (2.1 m east); the other stations agree to <= 1.3 m (stations[].derived.table_latlon_minus_xyz_enu_m).

Compact flux: P4 Appendix C.1 gives all synthetic models 0.6 Jy of compact flux, but the crescent of Eq. (49) integrates to I0 = 0.55 Jy (DERIVED). Observed: 0.66 (+0.16/-0.10) Jy (P4, 95%), typical 0.75 Jy from the P6 xs-ringauss fits (0.49-1.03 Jy by day), 0.5 Jy (DIFMAP, SMILI) and 0.6 Jy (eht-imaging) adopted for the fiducial images (P4 Sec. 7.1).

Ring diameter: 42 +- 3 uas (P1, P6 summary) vs the P6 GC-model weighted means 43.2-43.4 uas, the P4 image medians 40-41 uas, and the 44-uas synthetic crescent; P6 calibrates the geometric diameters with GRMHD models before quoting 42 +- 3.

Orientation: P1 gives 150-200 deg east of north; the P4 synthetic crescent uses eta = 150 deg; P4 Table 7 (April 11 images) 168-173 deg; P6 Table 3 (April 11 GC fit) 198 deg. P6 reports a shift of 20-50 deg between April 5-6 and 10-11.
Scan durations: 3-7 min (P2, P3) vs 4-7 min (P4 Fig. 1 caption).
notes: Stations: X_m, Y_m, Z_m, lat_deg, lon_deg (east positive) and h_m (GRS80) from P2 Table 2; dish_m = geometric diameter of one dish; dish_eff_m = P3 Table 2 "Diameter in 2017" (phased arrays: the diameter of the total collecting area, sqrt(N) x D); sefd_jy = P3 Table 2 median SEFD. GRS80 and WGS84 heights differ by < 1 mm here (stations[].derived).

uv convention, validated: with L = X(T1) - X(T2) from P2 Table 2, H = GST - RA from the SR1 AN header (GSTIA0, DEGPDY) and the SR1 M87 position, u = (sin H Lx + cos H Ly)/lambda and v = (-sin dec cos H Lx + sin dec sin H Ly + cos dec Lz)/lambda reproduce all 8058 SR1 (u, v) points of April 11 (high band) to 6.4e-05 of |uv| (max 346 m projected; AN-table positions give the same).

Observing pattern (DERIVED from the SR1 high-band csv files; observing.sr1_tracks): on the M87 target days the detections end when M87 has fallen to 20.7-23.9 deg at ALMA, as P3 states, and begin at the LMT at 13.3-16.2 deg (April 5, 6; the first LMT scans of April 11 were not detected). PV drops out at 10.5-15.9 deg, JCMT joins at 12.5-13.0 deg, SMA at 16.3-21.6 deg, SMT at 24.9-27.6 deg (41.4 deg on April 6). April 11: 0.53-7.52 h UTC, Greenwich hour angle of M87 +1.32 to +8.32 h (params.gst).
Positions for uv tracks: use X_m, Y_m, Z_m (P2 Table 2, 0.1 m); lat_deg and lon_deg come from the 0.1-arcsec table values (3 m) and serve for elevations.

Ring model for the page: the P4 Appendix C.1 crescent (r0 = 22 uas, A = 0.23, eta = 150 deg, I0 = 0.55 Jy, 10-uas blur) is the analytic image the EHT Collaboration used to test the imaging pipelines on April 11 coverage; ring_model.gc_fits gives the P6 April 11 fit (d = 42.4 uas, f_w = 0.34, phi = 198.1 deg, CF = 0.49 Jy) for a version matched to that day. P1 gives the headline values (42 +- 3 uas, width < 20 uas, contrast > 10:1, PA 150-200 deg).
SPT: in the array (P2, P3) but M87 (dec +12.4 deg) never rises there (DERIVED max elevation -12.4 deg); the SPT took part through 3C 279, which stays at 5.8 deg elevation (params.spt).
